note: Humanizer proposal for RC528 after two passes and a quality review (owner requests 2026-11-02: 'humanizer manuscript'; 'Use the humanize skill again to ensure nothing is missed that sounds like AI or would trigger AI detection software'; 'Before applying ensure none of the changes create grammar, spelling, or style errors.
